verdict.rationale: Lago's own llms.txt calls it "the open-source, real-time monetization platform," and its public GitHub repo (getlago/lago) can be checked out and run. A community thread names the license as AGPL, and the self-hosted Docker path confirms the code is available to run locally. missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license terms (AGPL appears only in a community comment), documentation on how the source is organized or how to navigate it.
